primary_coverage_audit.note: A metric is covered only when a verified numeric primary observation exists.

quality.rule: Optional primary feeds improve confidence but their absence alone must not block conclusions. Missing data still must not be converted into unsupported buy/sell conclusions.

evidence.confidence_method: weighted subcomponent coverage x critical FRED context multiplier

sq.rule: SQ is a short-lived market-structure overlay. Use it for staging and limit-order timing only; do not infer direction from open interest alone.

market_regime.rule: Regime is context, not a trade signal. If actionable=false, do not infer missing market facts.
market_regime.execution_rule: SQ may alter staging, patience, and limit-order execution only. It must not alter security ranking, fundamental score, or investment thesis.
market_regime.source_priority: official/public primary > internal v1.3 data > free secondary market feed > model inference
